prose: A post on X linked from Hacker News reports that OpenAI withdrew three of its mathematical results after the 6 October release. The post could not be fetched, so the reasons, which results were pulled and any OpenAI explanation are unknown to this summary.
Basis: headline only. It matters because OpenAI had said the catalogue mixed stages of verification and that corrections would be preserved as new versions.
highlights: OpenAI withdraws three mathematical results, per the headline
Source post on X not retrievable
Reasons and which results are unknown here
Fits OpenAI's warning that verification status varies
